acceptance: A refresh with a pin returns the pinned model
A pin to an absent model makes Refresh return an error
A pin applies when the prior catalog is reusable
A changed pin changes the catalog fingerprint
The strict policy decode refuses an unknown key under catalog.tier_pins
fix: Add catalog.tier_pins to the strict policy schema in go/internal/policy. Add a TierPins field to RefreshDeps and a pin step in modelquery liveTiers. A pin to a model that the CLI does not offer makes Refresh return an error; the catalog does not fall back to the detect map. A changed pin changes the fingerprint. Per plan open question Q3, a reviewed PR edits .evolve/policy.json directly until a verb exists.

summary: Component P2 (decisions D3 and D8) of the plan docs/plans/model-tier-policy-2026-10.md. The spec is docs/reference/model-routing.md (section The tier policy) and ADR-0136. The manifest offline default is not enough, because the live catalog overlays the tier picks.
